additionalFilterExpression.title: Additional filter expression
additionalFilterExpression.description: Extra Kibana Query Language (KQL) clause that is always AND-ed with every quick search. Use it to pre-narrow the catalog (assortment, brand, tags, additional properties, and similar) so typical searches run against a smaller set of items. This is not a default search term and is not shown or editable in the POS. Cashiers still type a query as usual. Leave unset, null, or empty for no extra filtering. Platform constraints still apply (sellable STOCK/SERVICE items, current sales prices, active identifiers, and item status). Invalid KQL makes quick search fail for all users — test the expression in the Complete Item query playground before rollout. KQL syntax: https://www.elastic.co/docs/explore-analyze/query-filter/languages/kql Complete Item fields and nested additional-property syntax: https://developer.hiiretail.com/docs/product-price-and-promotion/concepts/capabilities/querying-for-data/#how-it-works
